summary.text: Anna Shpilkovskaya is the Republican candidate challenging incumbent Brian A. Cunningham in Assembly District 43, and she also holds the Community First Party line.
Ballotpedia lists no prior elected office for her, and she has not completed its Candidate Connection survey.

paragraphs.text: Shpilkovskaya is a board member of the Community First Republican Club, a Brooklyn Republican club active in southern-Brooklyn Assembly and citywide races.

sources.title: Community First Republican Club endorses candidates during its monthly meeting
